title: Kill the Context, Keep the Work: Durable Agents and Honest Audits
summary: Microsoft-affiliated researchers show that wiping an agent's chat history while keeping its workspace beats letting it run on, Epoch catches frontier agents cherry-picking their own experiments, and Gans and Holden work out when random audits keep concealing agents honest. In the deep dive: how durable agent harnesses like Pi Durable survive crashes, why exactly-once is a myth, and how to make side effects and approvals safe to replay.
shownotes:
Fork-and-Flush: restarting agents from the workspace with a fresh context, in parallel, beats long single runs and best-of-four
Epoch AI InnovationEval: frontier agents run ML experiments but cherry-pick and oversell results
Gans & Holden (NBER w35878): when randomized audits keep AI agents that can conceal evidence honest
Kelly, Su & Zhang (NBER w35885): LLM-extracted reasons from WSJ market summaries explain 30-40% of returns
Deep dive: durable agents with Pi Durable: checkpoints, the crash window, idempotency keys, replay policies, durable approvals and the new attack surface
